integrity: Reproducible exhaustive face enumeration, global directed-Hasse DAG verification, signed integer Morse differentials, exact Smith normal forms; self-contained checker with SymPy dependency. Source dates refer to first public preprints.
scientific_limitations: Only \(k\in\{2,3,4\}\), with \(n=3k+2\); no general \(k\) formula, equivariant theory or independent certification. The open neighborhood complexes differ from the total-cut complexes.
title: Three exact homotopy types for neighborhoods of maximal squared-cycle packings
